image_query: Hoysaleswara Temple Halebidu carved pillar interior
tweets: The Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu, begun in 1121 CE, stands on soapstone pillars turned on a lathe like wood — each one symmetrical, yet no two carry quite the same pattern. Its twin shrines, Hoysaleswara and Shantaleswara, honour the Hoysala king and his queen.
